name: Kisaragi Tsugumi
source:
An amnesiac optimist whose favorite phrase is "Everything will work out." People naturally gather around him because he treats everyone fairly and he has a caring personality.

Because of his background, he doesn't usually doubt people. He's a good-natured person.

Was there a trauma that preceded his amnesia?
